input.title: Software Engineer
input.description:
We're hiring on behalf of a Haystack partner!


The Role


• Build virtualized, hardware-accelerated solutions for disk instances within a large-scale compute cloud infrastructure.

• Work across the full technology stack, from low-level hardware optimization to high-level frameworks supporting diverse workloads.

• Solve complex performance optimization and virtualization challenges while directly influencing product strategy and architecture.

• Collaborate within an engineering team dedicated to mentorship, knowledge sharing, and career development.


What You'll Need


• 5+ years of non-internship professional software development and programming experience in a Linux environment.

• 5+ years of experience leading the design, architecture, reliability, and scaling of new and existing systems.

• Demonstrated leadership experience as a mentor, tech lead, or engineering team leader.


What's On Offer


• Annual salary of $193,300 - $261,500 per year, plus sign-on payments, stock units, and comprehensive benefits.

• Flexible working hours and a culture that prioritizes work-life balance and personal fulfillment.

• Opportunities for continuous learning, career growth, and technical mentorship.


Apply via Haystack today!
